correctness.rationale: For the discrete binary parity random-unitary channel, the explicit two-state Stinespring environment is recovered by measuring parity at the output, proving degradability; number pinching increases coherent information at fixed energy. Conditional integer entropy maximization gives exactly the two geometric parity-class distributions and one-variable capacity. The objective is strictly concave: conditional cq entropy is concave and the thermal entropy is strictly concave. Small-q uniform expansions and a derivative-sign exponential bracket prove the e^-1 essential-singularity prefactor and r q/(ln 2) gain. Endpoints r=0 and r=1 verified. The embedded high-precision checker passed 382 finite assertions; these do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The concrete constrained optimizer is explicitly called for in the 2026 bosonic phase-capacity source. Binary 0/pi kicks are a natural atomic phase-noise regime with an infinite-dimensional Fock energy tradeoff. The exact parity-resolved geometric optimizer and essential singularity show that any incomplete parity erasure has a strictly positive, exponentially small odd-sector contribution; this nonperturbative operational behavior is not a textbook reformulation or merely a computed sample.
